source_audit.adapter_audit: opencl_adapter.py: full validation before any launch or buffer creation (dtype/ndim/shape/C-contiguity for sh/vs/vb f32 [B,P], sun/shade bool, solid/sine/cosine f32 [P], solar_gate bool [P] any-strides copied, sky_down/sky_side f32 [P] any-strides copied - stride-12 materialization inside timed boundary, lup f32 [B], directions f32/gate bool [P,4] validated but not passed), P range 1..609, surface scalar classification (both-f64 -> f64 kernel incl. python float; both-f32 -> f32 kernel; mixed rejected), reflection_factor float32-scalar-only. B==0 returns owned zeros((0,7)) without launching. Raise-only design: UnsupportedInput for unsupported inputs, DeviceUnavailable when no PoCL CPU device qualifies, raw cl.RuntimeError propagates for build/launch failures - there is no silent fallback path in the file. Device selection enumerates all platforms and requires PoCL platform name AND CL_DEVICE_TYPE_CPU AND available AND compiler AND cl_khr_fp64; Apple GPU/Rusticl excluded structurally; never auto-selects. Inputs never written (COPY_HOST_PTR host->device reads, const __global kernel args; canary-verified per call by the harness). cl.enqueue_copy of results + queue.finish() inside the adapter call, so the timed boundary includes validation, 12 per-call buffer copies, enqueue, sync, and host materialization. Context/queue/program created once per process and reused; buffers per call with no cross-call device caching (documented as a policy B must mirror).
source_audit.fp_methodology: verify_fp.py is genuinely discriminative: f32 contraction inputs are boundary-straddling (1+k*2^-12 products against c near -1 with 2^-23 perturbation, cancellation-amplified), device compared bitwise to separate-op host ground truth with 480/4096 cases where FMA would differ - so the check fails if contraction were ON; f64 and chain-shape ((S*x)*y)*z+acc -> f32 probes analogous; division check compares device / against correctly-rounded numpy f32 division over 19889 finite adversarial bit-pattern pairs (random uint32 mantissa/exponent spread + pathological ratios + subnormal results); denormal preservation and bool-multiplier NaN payload checked bitwise. Probes are built with the SAME options as the primary kernels and the same uppercase FP_CONTRACT OFF pragma. fp32 divide correctness is mandatory here because the PoCL CPU fp32 config does not advertise CL_FP_CORRECTLY_ROUNDED_DIVIDE_SQRT; -cl-fp32-correctly-rounded-divide-sqrt is accepted and recorded.
source_audit.timing_honesty: dev_timing.py/json is honestly labeled DEV-TIER / NOISY-HOST; 2 alternating paired reps (A-then-C, C-then-A) per workload with exactness cross-check before timing; C timed across the full adapter boundary. Recorded speedup_C_over_A = 0.9108 (B=16384) and 0.9423 (B=65536), i.e. C ~9%/6% slower - below the >=1.10x adapter gate and the >=1.20x kernel-only triage signal, and the author recommends NOT integrating on performance grounds. Claim matches evidence. (The proof record's sizing-probe numbers 26/356/364 ms do not match the retained dev_timing.json 22.3/24.6/26.3 ms - see finding F3; the retained numbers support the same conclusion, local_size=auto.)

The test passes (8,4)-shaped sun/shade against (8,610) visibility, so the adapter rejects at the earlier shape-consistency check ('sun: shape (8, 4) != (8, 610)') and the explicit range check at opencl_adapter.py:195-196 is never reached. The rejection outcome (pre-launch UnsupportedInput) is still real and the guard is trivially correct by inspection, but the claimed 'P=610' coverage is nominal, not actual.

findings.description: Stale/contradictory header comment in lw_primary.cl lines 13-16: it claims contraction is disabled by 'BOTH #pragma OPENCL FP_CONTRACT off (accepted since OpenCL C 1.2) and the -cl-fp-contract=off build option', while lines 34-38 of the same file and the proof record document that the lowercase spelling is ineffective on PoCL (compiles with a warning, contraction stays ON) and that PoCL 7.2 rejects the build option. findings.description: Replay canary bookkeeping is per-case-last-call: entry['input_canary'] is overwritten each call, and an input mutation with matching outputs would append to mismatch_detail but not increment 'mismatched', so the exit code would stay 0. No mutation occurred in the rerun (all canaries OK) and the adapter structurally cannot write host inputs (COPY_HOST_PTR reads + const __global args), so this is a harness-robustness nit, not an exactness gap.

The division check is finite-only: non-finite (NaN/Inf) numerator/denominator pairs are filtered before the 19889-case comparison. IEEE special-case propagation through '/' is instead covered transitively by the lup_nonfinite fixture replay and lup/lup_all adversarial combos (Inf/NaN numerators traverse the reflection divide) and PoCL fp32 advertises CL_FP_INF_NAN; combined coverage is adequate, but the division check alone would not catch a special-case bug.
findings.evidence: verify_fp.py lines 149-150 (finite filter); replay_log.json lup_nonfinite 4/4 bitwise; capability.json fp_config_float32.
